description: This file defines functions and constants for fetching, processing, and enriching public event data, including handling availability, user profiles, and event metadata within a calendar or scheduling application.

methods.name: getPublicEventSelect
methods.description: Defines the selection set for fetching public event data from the database, including related entities and specific fields.

methods.name: isCurrentlyAvailable
methods.description: Checks if a specific schedule is available at the current time, considering availability overrides and recurring availability.

methods.name: isAvailableInTimeSlot
methods.description: Determines if the current time falls within a specified availability time slot.

methods.name: getEventTypeHosts
methods.description: Enriches and returns host user data for a given event type, optionally fetching all user details.

methods.name: getPublicEvent
methods.description: Fetches and constructs detailed public event data, including user profiles, location filtering, permission checks, and metadata parsing.

methods.name: getProfileFromEvent
methods.description: Derives a user profile object from event data, prioritizing team, owner, and host information.

methods.name: getUsersFromEvent
methods.description: Retrieves user data associated with an event, including owner and hosts, with profile enrichment.

methods.name: getOwnerFromUsersArray
methods.description: Fetches the owner user data for an event from the database, enriching it with profile info.

methods.name: mapHostsToUsers
methods.description: Maps host data to user data format, including profile and organization info.

methods.name: processEventDataShared
methods.description: Processes and enriches event data, including availability checks and metadata parsing.
